name: JWH-018

tolerance.full: develops with prolonged and repeated use

addictionPotential: Moderately addictive with a high potential for abuse
toxicities: Exact toxic dose is unknown; the page warns long-term synthetic cannabinoid misuse is associated with serious adverse effects and deaths.
dosageRemark: Archived table lists threshold <1 mg; light 1-2 mg; moderate 2-3 mg; strong 3-5 mg; heavy 5 mg+. Total duration 1-2 h, onset 5-10 min, peak 60-90 min, offset 5-10 min, afterglow 60-90 min. Educational user/resource information, not a recommendation. Oral activity may occur when dissolved in lipids but gives no oral dose table.
generalRisks: Long-term synthetic cannabinoid misuse is linked to deaths and more dangerous adverse effects/toxicity than cannabis. Oral activity when dissolved in lipids is noted, with longer duration; no oral dose table is supplied.
longtermRisks: Long-term synthetic cannabinoid misuse is associated with multiple deaths and more dangerous adverse effects and toxicity than cannabis.
saferUse: Prolonged or high-dose use of synthetic cannabinoids is strongly advised against, and harm reduction is recommended.
The dose table is an educational user/resource compilation, not a recommendation; the source provides no oral dosage table.
summary: JWH-018 is a synthetic cannabinoid with limited safety data. FreeODwiki warns of greater harms with chronic or high-dose use and provides only an educational inhaled dose table.
